en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Watch a documentary on bugs
Watch a documentary on human trafficking
Watch a documentary on the police

I like Gonta, but his love for bugs is pretty
odd.

My island's got bugs that burrow into people's
brains, so people freak out around 'em.
Nyahaha! I get chills just thinking about 'em!
Oh! That's a lot of offerings!

If my island adopted this system, it would
resolve our offering shortage!

How divine of you, Shuichi! You taught me
something really useful!

I don't wanna watch something that's
gonna make me feel bad.

The police are heathens who always try
to disrupt my island's ceremonies.

They can't feel Atua's presence, so they
deny He even exists.
Are you a heathen too, Shuichi?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Angie looks deep in thought...
(Hmmm...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Angie's inner thoughts...?
